entries.zh: 想；思念（时常想着所爱之人）
entries.en: to think of; to keep the beloved in mind

entries.zh: 忆；忆念（想起所爱之人）
entries.en: to remember; to call the beloved to mind

entries.zh: 忆着；念念不忘所爱
entries.en: to dwell on in memory; to long for what one loves

entries.zh: 慕；爱慕、思慕
entries.en: to adore; to long for

entries.zh: 慕妻子；眷爱妻儿
entries.en: to love one's wife and children; to cherish one's family

entries.zh: 友；友爱（以兄弟之情相待）
entries.en: to befriend; to love as a brother

entries.zh: 友爱；兄弟或朋友之间相亲相爱
entries.en: brotherly love; mutual affection between brothers or friends
entries.notes: M 栏 ìn、R 栏 xièn 与「友」(iú/yǒu) 对音不密合，释义依 H「友爱」及 L「hermanos o amigos」定。

entries.zh: 情；情爱（所爱之人或物）
entries.en: affection; love (for a beloved person or thing)
entries.notes: M sêg、R cȳg 近「色」而 H 栏作「情」，音字不符；释义依 H 与 L「amada cosa」定。

entries.zh: 母子情；母子相爱之情
entries.en: mother-and-child affection; a mother's love for her children

entries.zh: 厚情；深情相爱
entries.en: deep affection; to love with warm feeling

entries.zh: 割吊人；为情所苦、相思成疾的人
entries.en: a lovesick person; one pining away with longing
entries.notes: R 栏有前置「(」且首音作 Cān，M 后半与「吊」不合；「割吊」为闽南语相思苦楚之词，义依 H 定。

entries.zh: 情；爱（泛称相爱之情）
entries.en: love; affection

entries.zh: 情动；为情所动、深爱
entries.en: to be deeply stirred by love; to love greatly
entries.notes: M ý、R y̌（上声）均指「已」而非「伊」，H 栏「情伊动」疑当作「情已动」。

entries.zh: 情好；情意相投、十分喜爱
entries.en: to be very fond of; to hold in warm affection
entries.notes: 同前条，音注作「已」，H 栏「情伊好」疑当作「情已好」。

entries.zh: 春心；动情（男女相爱抚之念）
entries.en: amorous stirrings; to be stirred with desire (as a woman caressing)

entries.zh: 狎爱；爱抚亲热（与女子调情）
entries.en: to fondle and caress amorously
entries.notes: H 栏三字（嫂敎人 [疑:敎/數]）与 M/R 二音节不合，hiāu 疑为「姣/嬈」（淫媚）之音；义仅据 L「amar la acariciando」推定。

entries.zh: 意愿；真心真意相爱
entries.en: to love sincerely; true-hearted devotion
entries.notes: M 音 guǎn 对应「愿」，R 栏 iēn 与之不密合；释义依 H「意愿」与 L「verdaderamente」定。

entries.zh: 思慕；思念爱慕（视所爱如己有）
entries.en: to long for; to think fondly of what one loves as one's own

entries.zh: 私情外意；不正当的私情、心向他人
entries.en: illicit private love; improper longing for another

entries.zh: 思念；思念不已（常挂嘴边）
entries.en: to miss; to keep thinking and speaking of the beloved

entries.zh: 思忆；思念与渴望
entries.en: to recall with longing; to think of and desire

entries.zh: 相疼（相痛）；夫妻或恋人彼此疼惜相爱
entries.en: to cherish each other; for spouses or lovers to love one another tenderly
entries.notes: L 栏「oen amoadre」残损，疑为「o enamorados」；R 栏 chiàng tōng 与 M 音不合，义依 H「相痛」（sio-thiànn，相疼）定。
